first_complete_output_rule: Once a complete new v0.3 prospective qualification output exists, scientific code, corpus, expectations, checker semantics, variant pairs, or gates may not change before exact archival regardless of pass/fail.

frozen_second_order_root_causes.diagnosed_manifestation: A bare reserved keyword/operator token followed by '(' can satisfy CALL_RE; `return (` produced a spurious CALL because the v0.2 exclusion was incomplete.
frozen_second_order_root_causes.name: BARE_RESERVED_KEYWORD_PARENTHESIS_FALSE_CALL
required_semantics: A bare JavaScript/TypeScript reserved keyword or control/operator token is never emitted as CALL solely because it is followed by an opening parenthesis.
The exclusion is lexical-context based, not fixture-name, source-hash, callee allowlist, or known-failure based.
A legal member call whose property name is keyword-like, including obj.return(...), remains a real CALL.
Existing declaration-aware CALL behavior, nested real calls, structural scope ownership, and exact call spans remain preserved.

frozen_second_order_root_causes.diagnosed_manifestation: Whole-object-body SHORTHAND_RE can promote an explicit property's RHS identifier before comma/brace into a false FIELD_BIND; alpha renaming changes whether the false label collides in the unique-field signature.
frozen_second_order_root_causes.name: OBJECT_SHORTHAND_RHS_IDENTIFIER_FALSE_FIELD
required_semantics: FIELD_BIND extraction is property-segment structural: each object brace pair is split only at commas at that brace depth while respecting nested (), [], and {}.

An explicit key:value property emits the key exactly once and derives rhs labels only from its value; identifiers inside the value are never promoted to shorthand fields merely because they precede comma or brace.
A true shorthand property emits exactly one FIELD_BIND only when the entire property segment is a supported identifier.
Nested object literals are processed independently so their own property keys remain observable.
Quoted supported property keys remain equivalent to identifier keys for field identity.
Unsupported computed, spread, method, or ambiguous property segments are omitted/fail-closed rather than guessed.

CALL-focused negative controls must assert total CALL count where zero-extra-call semantics are intended.
prospective_qualification.independent_checker_rule: Primary and independent qualification checkers must independently recompute expectations/signatures from frozen source bytes and must not import one another. Their agreement is checker-level independence only; no claim of independent frontend implementation is permitted.

prospective_qualification.metamorphic_rule: Every declared base/variant pair must independently satisfy exact frozen expectations and have equal normalized signature consisting of CALL count, COMPARE count, RETURN count, representation count, sorted exact representation field arities, and sorted FIELD_BIND counts inside representations. Source bytes, names, quotes, whitespace, and spans may change.
